title: Woven memory
alt: A continuous wall tapestry depicts a dense hillside town through raised embroidery and colored thread.
description: Streets, stairs, balconies and gardens resolved as woven relief, with visible fibers and an unfinished edge.
prompt: A breathtaking contemporary wall tapestry depicting a richly detailed imaginary hillside city in warm coral, cream, indigo and mustard. Streets, stairs, roofs, balconies and tiny gardens are woven into one continuous fabric surface using different thread densities and raised embroidery. The buildings remain a flat textile representation rather than becoming real miniature buildings. At one lower corner, a short unfinished edge reveals loose threads attached to the same weaving. Large-scale museum installation photographed straight-on with subtle side light, exquisitely visible fibers, sophisticated composition and coherent architectural silhouettes, no words or lettering.
